commands.commandLine: powershell.exe -Command '$ref=(Get-Content .'"\\REFERENCE_BINARY.txt -Raw).Trim(); "'$cases=@(@('"'count','sample.csv'),@('headers','sample.csv'),@('select','c,a','sample.csv'),@('slice','--start','1','--len','1','sample.csv'),@('search','y','sample.csv'),@('sort','--select','a','sample.csv'),@('fmt','--out-delimiter','|','sample.csv'),@('frequency','--limit','0','sample.csv'),@('stats','sample.csv'),@('table','sample.csv')); foreach("'$case in $cases){$name=$case[0]; $argv=$case[1..($case.Length-1)]; & $ref $name @argv > ref.bin 2>ref.err; $rc1=$LASTEXITCODE; python .'"\\xsv_port.py "'$name @argv > py.bin 2>py.err; $rc2=$LASTEXITCODE; $h1=(Get-FileHash ref.bin).Hash;$h2=(Get-FileHash py.bin).Hash; Write-Output "$name rc=$rc1/$rc2 out=$($h1 -eq $h2) err=$((Get-FileHash ref.err).Hash -eq (Get-FileHash py.err).Hash)"; if($h1 -ne $h2){Write-Output REF; [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes('"'ref.bin'));Write-Output PY;[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes('py.bin'))}}"
